chapters.title: The agent fabric and its economics
Starting small and building the fabric

takeaways: Cloud teams have more observability data than ever; the bottleneck is reasoning across fragmented tools, not visibility.
Azure Copilot agents for migration, deployment, optimization, observability, resiliency and troubleshooting work best as a coordinated fabric with shared context.
Scoped Entra identities, Azure Policy, tiered approvals and audit logs keep agents governed; start with one agent, one problem and a measured baseline.
hook: Cloud teams drown in dashboards from Azure Monitor, Cost Management and Advisor, yet still miss the patterns that matter. This episode is for Azure platform engineers and cloud leaders who want to see how Azure Copilot agents form a synthetic platform team, how to secure and govern them, and how to start with a single agent pilot.
